definitions.explanation: The creation of a new device or process.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発明|はつめい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{偉大|いだい}な→偉大：01798_idai⟧{発明|はつめい}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think the telephone is a great invention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発明|はつめい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The invention of printing technology greatly changed the course of world history.

notes:
{発明|はつめい} means invention or the act of inventing. As a verbal noun, it forms {発明|はつめい}する (to invent).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～を{発明|はつめい}する: to invent something
- {偉大|いだい}な{発明|はつめい}: a great invention
- {新|あたら}しい{発明|はつめい}: a new invention

RELATED WORDS:
- {発明家|はつめいか}: inventor
- {発明品|はつめいひん}: invented product
- {発見|はっけん}: discovery (finding something existing)
- {開発|かいはつ}: development

DISTINCTION:
{発明|はつめい} is creating something new that didn't exist before, while {発見|はっけん} is finding something that already existed but was unknown.
